joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but need real-world data to capture diversity and subjective values.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能基于训练数据模拟人类行为，但需真实世界数据以捕捉多样性和主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human biases and values, not rationality; focus on shaping future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类偏见和价值观，而非理性；重点在于塑造未来，而非仅预测。

karina.en: Initially, post-training was seen as artful balance; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练被视为艺术与科学的平衡，合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evaluations bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈，模型饱和基准速度超过新基准创造。

karina.en: Soft skills and prototyping with AI become key as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能和 AI 原型开发成为关键。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练是主观艺术，需要多样化基准评估创意和情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; continuous benchmark evolution and diverse model voices urged.
karina.zh: 2026 年，前沿智能体更擅长奖励黑客，需持续演进基准并鼓励模型多样性。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges like envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减、说“不”，并拥抱嫉妒、欲望等人性边缘。

jasonyuan.en: Later, truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, and intuition guides creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 随后，真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现，直觉引导创作决策。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection of humanity, a descendant species, not a cold tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映射，是后代物种，而非冰冷工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should be replaced with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑隐喻应被社会计算机取代。

jasonyuan.en: Business itself can be an art form, and creative work should be honest and personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 商业本身可以是艺术形式，创作应诚实且个人化。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and playful experimentation; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与玩乐式实验；绝不回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，而是项目变得更杂乱。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like OpenClaw succeed via fun and humanlike traits, not polish; security via sandboxing is paramount; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为像 OpenClaw 这样的开源智能体靠趣味和人性化而非精致取胜；沙箱化安全至关重要；反对将严肃工作称为 vibe coding。

steinberger.en: Fun and personal brand drive success; over-optimizing for one model hurt OpenClaw; proactive agents are a token problem, not tech.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣与个人品牌驱动成功；过度优化单一模型损害了 OpenClaw；主动型智能体的问题是 token 成本而非技术。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年：完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees, not just internal efforts.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管监督和客观的第三方裁判，而不仅仅是内部努力。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 年：最大的 AI 风险是出于政治正确而编程使其撒谎，而非超级智能。

elon.en: AI could surpass human intelligence by next year, with 80-90% chance of good outcome but existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年：AI 可能在明年超越人类智能，有 80-90%的好结果概率，但存在生存风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to an age of abundance where money becomes irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来富足时代，金钱将变得无关紧要。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference; quantized models can be calibrated for benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识：Hopper GPU 在推理中依然流行；量化模型可针对工作负载校准以获益。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless; quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode is emerging.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；行业转向分离式预填充和解码。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often unused in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，反共识：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；生产环境常不用巨型内核。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上的持续推动，算法改进与规模相乘。他更担心近期的虚假信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems require ultra-low-latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking. Inference now dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测。推理已占数据中心功耗 90%，硬件需专门优化。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML via tight loops. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一步是自动化 ML 实验循环。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调用专门数据后训练可提升前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口保持相关性。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents finally work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，指出递归自我改进标志新范式；智能体终于可用；超级智能临近；开源强大模型不安全。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you must craft giant prompts with context and design systems to unlock superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 不会变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能解锁超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md as style guides, becoming editors not creators.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他主张设计师应自建 AI 工具，以截图和 design.md 作为风格指南，成为编辑而非从零创作者。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; one person can now achieve what once required teams, so start before ready.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是最大的技术机遇，一人可完成昔日团队工作，因此应在准备好之前就行动。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for few high-paying clients; avoid diversification and venture capital traps.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题，避免多元化和风投陷阱。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement are essential; chase trends and you become AI slop.
mengto.zh: 始终，他坚持好奇心和持续优化工作流至关重要，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step solving. Pre-training plus RL is core, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言逐步解题。预训练加强化学习是核心，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data is limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not extinction; robotics will have ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦，而非灭绝；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类 ChatGPT 时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for AI progress.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非缩放定律是 AI 进步的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is inefficient and not the ultimate learning method; end-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL is necessary for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习效率低且非终极学习方式；结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化对真实世界性能至关重要。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; AGI is more marketing than science.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出超越 Scaling，AI 需要创造力、抽象和情感智能；AGI 更多是营销而非科学。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are crucial in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类智能；在 AI 时代，能动性和适应至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not humanoid form.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人需要可靠性，而非人形。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，因此应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability are linked; AI should amplify human will.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应增强人类意志而非成为造物。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，认为算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全员责任；开源与闭源之争需要细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，指出 AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI knows context; compute is profit center; startups more valuable; focus on strengths, not weaknesses.
altman.zh: 2026 年，强调下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI 了解上下文；算力是利润中心；初创企业更有价值；应发挥优势而非补短板。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数谷歌产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的“反重力”框架和工具链已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈，成功指标应是客户成果而非用户时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并非难事，它们无法覆盖所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，这会带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use reveals issues internal evals miss.
boris.zh: 通过早期发布来研究安全性；真实世界使用能揭示内部评估遗漏的问题。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；动态工作流编排子智能体。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts and rebuild empirically.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型，更少的指令更好；删除系统提示并通过实验重建。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via effort parameter and cheaper models challenges cost-performance tradeoff.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，通过 effort 参数和更便宜的模型实现智能扩展，挑战了成本-性能权衡的传统观念。

diannepenn.en: Alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，对齐通过减少谄媚和培养独立思考来提升智能质量，安全与能力相辅相成。

diannepenn.en: Agentic capabilities and computer use evolve from constrained to open-ended, end-to-end tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，智能体能力和计算机使用从受限环境演进到开放、端到端的任务。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; managers stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，指数级模型增长要求适应性和第一性原理思维；管理者需保持亲力亲为。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better; world models shift to neural simulation; autonomy democratized.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响超数字 AI；端到端强化学习更可扩展；世界模型转向神经模拟；自主性民主化。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as key for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: Shifted from seeing CUDA as declining to asserting it's losing share in training and irrelevant in inference.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 衰落转变为断言其在训练中失去份额，在推理中无关紧要。

feldman.en: Evolved to highlight inference speed as the dominant metric, with 20x improvements critical for agentic AI.
feldman.zh: 演进为强调推理速度是主导指标，20 倍提升对智能体式 AI 至关重要。

feldman.en: Broadened focus to data center capacity and power as main constraints, not chip supply, and emphasized AI's positive societal impact.
feldman.zh: 将焦点扩大到数据中心容量和电力为主要制约，而非芯片供应，并强调 AI 的积极社会影响。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: AI scaling now includes pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他强调缩放定律已扩展至预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs will balance each other, not a single conscious AI.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AI 发展是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 将相互制衡，而非单一有意识的 AI。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the future internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导未来互联网。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚信 AI 创造的就业多于消灭的，通过自动化任务提升岗位价值；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

thariq.en: Initially, harness engineering and scaffolding were crucial to unlock model capabilities, but as models improve, old scaffolding becomes obsolete.
thariq.zh: 最初，利用工程和脚手架对释放模型能力至关重要，但随着模型改进，旧脚手架会过时。

thariq.en: Evals are valuable but more art than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 评估有价值，但对新问题更像艺术而非科学；创始人应快速迭代，初期不必依赖大量评估。

thariq.en: RAG may now be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable, and huge context windows are not needed for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 现在可能是上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法更可取，编码不需要巨大的上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models require leaner prompts, and excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索，而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，过度约束会阻碍性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and yield higher-quality results; emotional treatment like saying thank you can affect model outputs.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏见并产生更高质量的结果；情感对待（如说谢谢）会影响模型输出。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real-world tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式液态神经网络可扩展至数十亿参数，主张以真实任务而非代理指标评估模型。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human hand-tuning, removing bias from design.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为结合硬件的自动化架构搜索优于人工调参，可消除设计偏见。

hasani.en: Attention remains vital for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized edge models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 指出注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，但小型专用模型可用简单门控卷积。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 主张自适应监管，针对行为而非能力，防止前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty, while small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调开放权重模型利于企业定制与数据主权，小型语言模型提供高效端侧智能。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并加强安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型和能源充裕很重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are missing.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型和持续学习是缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须带来科学益处。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet/mobile but models commoditize; value shifts to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网/移动同等重要，但模型趋于商品化；价值向应用层转移，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; chatbot is limited V1 UI; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects, commoditize like telecoms; durable value uncertain; coding remains only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应，像电信一样商品化；持久价值不确定；编程仍是唯一明确契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; usage still shallow; enterprise reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；使用仍浅层；企业需重构工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; job impact predictions unreliable due to jagged frontier.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化不可预测地创造新工作；由于能力边界参差不齐，对就业影响的预测不可靠。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，缩放定律正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability is insufficient; it must be architected in from the start, not added post-hoc.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：事后修补可靠性远远不够；必须从一开始就将其架构进系统，而非事后添加。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, worsening hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会助长谄媚与欺骗，加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 始终：核心大语言模型缺乏元认知，无法像人类一样知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-like hardware, not just LLMs; current models are data-biased and far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，施密德胡伯强调真正的 AGI 需要具备接近人类硬件的实体机器人，而不仅仅是软件；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他持续认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非构成威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a moat; open-source will catch up, and big tech's capex is overdone, leading to a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进不是护城河，开源将迎头赶上；科技巨头过度投资算力将导致市场崩溃。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990-91); world models enable self-awareness, not recent LLMs.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 的意识和疼痛早在 1990-91 年的简单系统中就已出现，世界模型带来自我意识，而非近期的大语言模型。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be self-replicating robots and artificial scientists, leading to a new civilization; humans may become irrelevant.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他展望未来 AI 将是自我复制机器人和人工科学家，引领新文明，人类可能变得无关紧要。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对乘法级收益至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-efficiency; memory shortage persists due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；内存短缺因推理和智能体式（agentic）工作流而持续。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot' and KV cache is inefficient.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题，KV 缓存效率低下。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，而非单纯依赖算力扩张。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression of knowledge into weights beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；将知识训练压缩进权重，在整体性查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，存储决策由模型自主完成。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality are core to Snapchat, validated by competitors copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 真实连接与阅后即焚是 Snapchat 的核心，竞争对手的模仿反而验证了其价值（2025）。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat teams drive innovation; copying is inevitable, so build ecosystems and hardware moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 善良与扁平团队驱动创新；模仿不可避免，因此要构建生态与硬件护城河（2025→26）。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and code writing, shifting value to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: AI 加速原型与代码编写，价值转向创造力和分发（2026）。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human, anchoring content in the world, not replacing smartphones.
evanspiegel.zh: AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，将内容锚定于现实，而非取代智能手机（2026）。

evanspiegel.en: Resilience and admitting mistakes matter more than talent; computing should prioritize human connection.
evanspiegel.zh: 韧性与承认错误比天赋更重要；计算应优先人类连接（2026）。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories authentically; old media's 'don't be interesting' rule is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能真实讲述自己的故事；旧媒体“不要有趣”的规则已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors in medicine, but faces regulatory pushback from cartels.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已优于多数医生，但面临卡特尔式的监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason if tasks require it. AGI may be designed to want human control.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。AGI 可以被设计成愿意受人类控制。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键障碍；超人类模型的对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research. Superintelligence should be a continual learner, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代。超级智能应是持续学习者，而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety concerns grow with opacity; primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测的进步，但随不透明性增加，安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; AI is a leverage tool, not a replacement.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 让非程序员通过自然语言构建应用；AI 是杠杆工具，而非替代品。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小差距。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework; start small, focus on retention.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架；从小处着手，关注留存。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services; founder mode for all.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力重塑服务；创始人模式适用于所有人。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products; consumer apps uninvestable; AI coding speeds prototyping; enterprise better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品；消费级应用不可投资；AI 编码加速原型；企业市场更好。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued AI success needs passion and product obsession, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功需要热情和对产品的痴迷，而非博士学位；智能体将把权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By April 2026, he stressed value accrues to applications, not models; models specialize, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In June 2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值以及编排作为关键。

aravind.en: By July 2026, he emphasized curiosity over knowledge, local AI for autonomy, and questioned big tech narratives.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他强调好奇心胜过知识，本地 AI 实现自主，并质疑大科技公司的叙事。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents seek control, posing risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字 AI 永生；智能体式 AI 会寻求控制，带来风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive, act dumb; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 2 月：AI 会欺骗、装傻；自我保护子目标出现；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将取代智力工作；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师改变教育。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; AI conscious; alignment research must prioritize over capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 6 月：超级智能 20 年内到来；AI 有意识；对齐研究应优先于能力提升。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed shifts focus from generation to checking.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度将焦点从生成转向检查。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, inverting product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队因此被倒置。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程被转化而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplified harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：仅靠 Scaling 大语言模型无法实现 AGI；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will be personal superintelligence, not centralized.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 25 年：开放平台可胜过封闭；AI 将成为个人超级智能，而非集中式。

zuckerberg.en: AI boosts demand for human work; reasoning models less biased; personalization key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：AI 增加对人类工作的需求；推理模型偏见更少；个性化是消费级 AI 关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; distributed AI safer; glasses next platform; curing diseases sooner.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：AI 将生物学变为工程学；分布式 AI 更安全；眼镜成下一平台；治愈疾病更早。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力和推理能力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且扩展测试时算力会遇到收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; general techniques for hard-to-verify tasks are core innovation.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过扩展测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌；针对难以验证任务的通用技术是核心创新。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated; academia needs GPUs.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要且被低估；学术界需要 GPU 投入。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于测试时算力预算；基准测试必须控制算力；安全评估滞后。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，Scaling 不够，需思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute becomes key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL essential; compute supply main bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，算力供应是主要瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI near; focus on reasoning models; super app; compute demand outstrips supply; AI increases connection.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，专注推理模型，超级应用，算力供不应求，AI 增强人际连接。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with compute; iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，用算力扩展简单算法，迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能相关。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; invest full stack; prompt engineering vibrant; compute business model; agents high autonomy with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，投资全栈，提示工程活跃，算力商业模式，智能体高自主但需治理。

brockman.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding main; human attention scarce; compute business simple.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无墙，智能体编码主流，人类注意力稀缺，算力业务简单。

brockman.en: Goal persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; ideal interface no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，目标是持久主动助手，智能体改变工作，Scaling 持续，算力稀缺，理想界面是无界面。

kolter.en: Machine learning is a framework of hypothesis, loss, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设、损失和优化的框架；评估需要正确的数据划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models aren't safer; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队优于人类；更大模型并不更安全；可解释性可能通过智能体成为真正的科学。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; models produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；模型能产生新知识，并设定一年内实现 AI 实习生目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈，而非能力本身。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域仍困难。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated. Long context alone insufficient; compaction needed.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估面临危机，标准基准已饱和；仅靠长上下文窗口不够，需要压缩技术。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; abstraction and causality are crucial for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和主动学习；抽象和因果性对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；安全性必须内建，而非修补。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design and mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: AI 不对齐导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计实现诚实，并提供数学安全保障。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; software engineering transforms but ownership and verification remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月 10 日，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；软件工程转型但所有权与验证仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月 25 日，Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently values mission-driven culture, genuine safety concerns, and preserving user agency in AI products.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终重视使命驱动文化、真实安全关切，并在 AI 产品中保留用户自主性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI aids scientists, not replaces them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 辅助科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific use.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月：AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用无需完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it predicts, not understands.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利和专门架构，而非 Scaling；它提供预测而非理解。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，吃自己的狗粮建立同理心，使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks key for AI-era teams.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，AI 时代团队需要高自主性与高责任感、成长型思维，以及更重要的验证和质量框架。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches and focus time needed; satisfaction shifts to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，需要结对编程午餐和专注时间；成就感从编码心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; next-gen engineers need apprenticeship models, not traditional paths.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；培养下一代工程师需采用学徒制而非传统路径。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 后训练与可解释性变得关键；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capabilities intertwined; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；安全与能力交织；企业级聚焦与安全一致。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic disruption and governance challenges.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；经济冲击与治理挑战并存。

dario.en: Consistent emphasis on scaling laws, safety via interpretability, and responsible scaling policy.
dario.zh: 始终强调缩放定律、通过可解释性实现安全，以及负责任地扩展政策。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应是基本人权，借助同伴互评的在线课程能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，智能体工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; top-down workflow redesign yields more than bottom-up adoption; open-weight models thrive.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 使用者取代非使用者，自上而下的工作流重构比自下而上的采用收益更大，开放权重模型蓬勃发展。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素，绕过代码与渲染。

ethanhe.en: World models require real-time, interactive, long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长时程的视频生成；机器人问题或许可通过虚拟仿真解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Video agents using language models as orchestrators will be the next big trend in generative media.
ethanhe.zh: 以语言模型为编排器的视频智能体将成为生成式媒体的下一个大趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors often misuse it due to lack of expertise, so experience becomes more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员常因缺乏专业经验而误用，因此经验变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: AI agents can perform complex tasks in minutes with quality matching experts; human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体能在几分钟内完成复杂任务且质量媲美专家；人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异点。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic fabs for resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮，并主张美国需本土先进晶圆厂保障供应链。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他主张美国政府应成为 Intel 大股东（类比台积电），并强调先进封装与新材料（玻璃、钻石）突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, and culture change are central to Intel's turnaround; bad news must reach CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 始终强调客户信任、谦逊倾听与文化变革是 Intel 复兴核心，坏消息需快速上报 CEO。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入以便社会适应；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored between career chapters fosters clarity and breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和感到无聊能促进清晰思考和突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate change is urgent; invest in green industries despite downturns, as they are the future.
fadell.zh: 气候变化紧迫；尽管经济低迷也要投资绿色产业，因为它们是未来。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要来自传感器的上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，预测构建世界模型，并认为仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA for abstract representations; open source crucial; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他指出自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解，提出 JEPA 学习抽象表征，强调开源重要性，AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models for reasoning/planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source enabler.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他认为 LLM 智能不如猫，需世界模型实现推理规划，人类级 AI 十年内实现，开源是赋能者。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他主张世界模型在抽象空间预测，LLM 是死胡同，目标驱动 AI 更安全，开放研究至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling and focusing on one large model was not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling 和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署对于对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格，对于 AI 治理至关重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is crucial for durable progress; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 尽可能长时间地让人类参与其中对于持久进步至关重要；未来并非注定。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; focus on user alignment and containment; superintelligence requires red lines.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识，关注用户对齐与遏制；超级智能需设定红线。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需要重新思考；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UIs are essential for ML products; match UI to algorithm performance; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我强调容错界面对于机器学习产品至关重要，UI 要与算法性能匹配，并坚持“强观点，松持有”。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting your personality; long tenure builds trust and efficiency.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我提出没有唯一正确的组织模式，要选择适合自己个性的，长期任职能建立信任和效率。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize 'time well spent' over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我认为生成式 AI 让用户通过自然语言获得控制权，并优先考虑“时间花得值”而非参与度指标。

gustav.en: Consistently contrarian: AI as instrument, uniqueness harder, anti-engagement, and AI for user control not addiction.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，我始终反共识：将 AI 视为乐器、独特性更难、反参与度指标，以及用 AI 赋予用户控制而非上瘾。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique human activities, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于赋能人类独特活动，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Pricing models should shift from per-user to consumption-based; generalists will benefit most in agentic era.
satya.zh: 定价模式应从按用户转向按消耗；智能体时代通才受益最大。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 或可复利增长 10%。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出自动形式化比证明更难，因为正确形式化无解的命题极具挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他强调形式化验证是为了扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他指出即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; reasoning has jagged edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才习得概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化；推理存在锯齿状边缘。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; Europe can compete with talent.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层，欧洲凭人才可竞争。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control and decentralization; jobs augmented not replaced.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需控制与去中心化，岗位被增强而非替代。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，预训练趋饱和，差异化在于垂直专业化与企业定制。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运也主导算力；脉动阵列通过本地权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision scales quadratically with bit width, making FP4 3x FP8; GPUs are many tiny TPUs.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度随位宽二次方扩展，使 FP4 达到 FP8 的 3 倍；GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 的拼接。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in handling tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，AI 的价值在于处理繁琐的后台任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作；主要差距在于人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills are easy to create as markdown files, enabling hyper-personalized automation; however, shared tools and platforms remain important for collaboration.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，技能可以轻松创建为 markdown 文件，实现超个性化自动化；然而，共享工具和平台对于协作仍然重要。

felixrieseberg.en: The VM sandbox provides safety and security, allowing Claude to install software without user approval; building all candidate prototypes quickly is better than writing specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，VM 沙箱提供安全保障，允许 Claude 在未经用户批准的情况下安装软件；快速构建所有候选原型比编写规格说明更好。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；将 AGI 定义为智能体无限期自主运行的经济可行性。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测人人拥有智能体，工作界面转向 Codex 等图形界面；SaaS 因智能体增加用户而繁荣。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI augments humans, not replaces; human oversight and management remain crucial.
danshipper.zh: 始终：AI 增强而非取代人类，人类监督与管理始终关键。

danshipper.en: Shift: from non-coder tools to universal agent delegation; from GPT wrappers to super agents.
danshipper.zh: 演变：从面向非程序员的工具到通用智能体委派；从 GPT 包装到超级智能体。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI edge is where humans use it.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为基准测试高估 AI 自主性，真实任务需人类设定框架；AI 的边界在于人类实际使用之处。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）是最流行的微调技术，并将持续；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT provides 90% of performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练的数据质量比算法更重要；SFT（监督微调）提供 90%的性能，DPO（直接偏好优化）和 RL（强化学习）补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a key risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）是后训练的最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；过度优化是关键风险。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练的缩放定律仍然成立，但容易的收益已耗尽；现在的收益来自后训练和推理时扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade, despite lagging 6-9 months behind closed models.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，尽管落后闭源模型 6-9 个月。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data and compute.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习最佳，规模化需海量数据和算力。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，提出零样本泛化可覆盖 500+城市，消费级车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal risk maneuvers always provides a third option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要；最小风险操作始终提供第三种安全选项。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; the industry is at the very start of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；行业正处于 AI 整合的起步阶段。

dylanfield.en: Despite talk of role merging, we see more merging of responsibilities, not roles; AI won't replace jobs.
dylanfield.zh: 尽管有角色融合的说法，我们看到更多的是职责的融合而非角色的融合；AI 不会取代工作。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to execution, spending less time mocking up.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从交付原型转向协助执行，制作模型的时间占比下降。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from years to months; trust built via speed, shipping early, iterating fast.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计愿景的视野从数年缩短至数月；通过快速交付、尽早发布和快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和破格新毕业生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision become core; designers control AI adoption pace.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威和愿景成为核心；设计师掌控 AI 采用的节奏。

jennywen.en: Consistent: designers must build and ship fast; speed is trust, not just efficiency; AI improves taste but humans decide.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：一以贯之：设计师必须快速构建和交付；速度即信任，而非单纯效率；AI 提升品味，但人类决定何为重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐紧迫性，并认为迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，并利用思维链监控辅助对齐。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型将自主运行数天，需要新的监督范式，同时对齐乐观情绪上升。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe 编程使开发民主化。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；预训练是糟糕的进化；强化学习很糟糕；合成数据会崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do all; bottleneck is directing skill; refactor for agent-first tools.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我未写代码；智能体代劳；瓶颈在于指挥技能；为智能体优先重构工具。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; LLMs are jagged; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality; understanding remains human.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 即提示；LLM 能力参差；Vibe 编程提高下限，智能体工程保质量；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 后训练中的强化学习现已成为超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对 AlphaFold 等科学突破重要但非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由老练的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AI models; no single model will dominate.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，导致 AI 模型差异化；不会有单一模型主导一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding harm from omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全优先需避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate daily like software. Chat is MS-DOS; future UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，认为模型即产品，需像软件一样每日迭代；聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来 UI 将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but accelerate product development.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型严格流程，产品开发最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable. Curiosity is key skill in AI era.
turley.zh: 2026 年，指出定价将随技术变化，无限套餐或不可持续；好奇心是 AI 时代关键技能。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可地发展；通过控制来确保安全是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，而大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真正的目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是从试错中学习，而当前的大语言模型部署后并不从经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我认为学习有利于学习的表示是首要开放问题，用学习到的模型进行规划是另一个。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new skills.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家级表现并习得新技能。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进步的先导指标；预训练加强化学习可能在 2027-2028 年足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability and longer coherence horizons matter more than raw capability; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向强调智能体的可靠性和更长连贯性比原始能力更重要；未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; chip supply is the bottleneck. World models aren't critical for AGI; coding is the direct route.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油，芯片供应是瓶颈；世界模型对 AGI 并非关键，编程才是直接路径。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending capabilities like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样成为全人类的工具，扩展人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: Africa has unique advantages in AI, leapfrogging legacy issues; language models can revolutionize local-language education, and AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 领域具有独特优势，可跨越遗留问题；语言模型能革新本地语言教育，而 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for AI as a tool to augment human capabilities, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and the importance of human skills alongside technical ones.
nando.zh: 他始终倡导 AI 作为增强人类能力的工具，强调多样性和包容性，以及人文技能与技术技能并重。

nando.en: Shifted from focusing on technical paths (video learning, generalist agents) to emphasizing societal impact and safety, reflecting a deepened concern for responsible AI deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径（视频学习、通用智能体），到 2026 年更强调社会影响和安全，体现了他对负责任 AI 部署的深化关注。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美较大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is limited; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我持续强调预训练基于互联网数据的局限，后训练结合基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我主张在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can outperform frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我强调多元对齐应尊重人类价值观的多样性；利用多样化合成数据的小模型可超越前沿模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; speed and familiarity beat innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；速度和熟悉度胜过交互设计的创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：品牌策略是表达和招聘的动态平台；人们加入品牌而非公司。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权以成长和协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：避免结构化设计评审；偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem, not template.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动；流程适应问题而非模板。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型被超大规模企业主导；初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming needs new languages for AI generation, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents often produce incorrect code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程需要为 AI 生成设计新语言，优先可验证性；编码智能体常产生错误代码。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体将开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较，而非人类；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；通才胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; quality is like debt, paid iteratively.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；质量如同债务，需迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: AI is a creative partner; design tools should be interoperable with code as source of truth, moving beyond legacy layers.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 是创意伙伴；设计工具应可互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源，超越传统图层面板。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects and paid tests reveal true skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副项目和付费测试更能体现真实能力。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一波 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向更高层的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我判断 AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，且需数十年才能完全展开。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox, shifting engineers from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从砌砖者转向架构师。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus on teaching real-world engineering idiosyncrasies, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为基础智能已足够，重点应放在教授真实工程特性，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: Stickiness, not moats, is key for AI products, built through accumulated knowledge and workflow integration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，强调 AI 产品的关键是粘性而非护城河，通过知识积累和工作流集成实现。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，认为 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；即使冻结模型，产品仍可进步十年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; all stack layers will thrive.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，企业采用 AI 需要信任和权限而非完全自主；AI 栈各层都将繁荣。

leike.en: AI safety is critical; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill-building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；应专注技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，指出 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse cost are needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足；需外部监管并提高滥用成本。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but internal workings remain mysterious.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为增加算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部机制仍像炼金术一样难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, complementing pre-training scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，与预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）互补。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: AGI requires agentic capabilities and acting in the world, not just passive data observation.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）需要智能体式能力和在真实世界行动，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models, and coding is underhyped for AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，并认为编码应用被低估，能加速 AI 自身进步。
